scientific_integrity: All-parameter proofs for gap encoding, connectivity, local degrees, counts and girth; two different executable finite checks through n=18 and n=27; no independent external audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Simple labeled cycles n>=7; inclusion-maximal induced matchings and one-edge exchanges only; no claimed exact diameters of triangle-containing sectors; possible unindexed prior equivalent formulations.
title: Exchange geometry of maximal induced matchings on cycles
